crossrefs.text: We even saw the Nephilim there—the descendants of Anak that come from the Nephilim! We seemed like grasshoppers in our own sight, and we must have seemed the same to them!”
Once again the Philistines waged war against Israel, and David and his servants went down and fought against the Philistines. But David became exhausted.
So these four descendants of Rapha in Gath fell at the hands of David and his servants.
You were patient with them for many years, and Your Spirit admonished them through Your prophets. Yet they would not listen, so You gave them into the hands of the neighboring peoples.
(For only Og king of Bashan had remained of the remnant of the Rephaim. His bed of iron, nine cubits long and four cubits wide, is still in Rabbah of the Ammonites.)
Then a champion named Goliath, who was from Gath, came out from the Philistine camp. He was six cubits and a span in height,
(That too was regarded as the land of the Rephaim, who used to live there, though the Ammonites called them Zamzummites.
They were a people great and many, as tall as the Anakites. But the LORD destroyed them from before the Ammonites, who drove them out and settled in their place,

notes.title: The sons of God and the daughters of humans

crossrefs.text: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murder, adultery, sexual immorality, theft, false testimony, and slander.
Furthermore, since they did not see fit to acknowledge God, He gave them up to a depraved mind, to do what ought not to be done.
They are senseless, faithless, heartless, merciless.
For from within the hearts of men come evil thoughts, sexual immorality, theft, murder, adultery,
All these evils come from within, and these are what defile a man.”
Wash the evil from your heart, O Jerusalem, so that you may be saved. How long will you harbor wicked thoughts within you?
The heart is deceitful above all things and beyond cure. Who can understand it?
And you were dead in your trespasses and sins,
Both of them were righteous in the sight of God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and decrees of the Lord.
By faith Noah, when warned about things not yet seen, in godly fear built an ark to save his family. By faith he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness that comes by faith.
if He did not spare the ancient world when He brought the flood on its ungodly people, but preserved Noah, a preacher of righteousness, among the eight;
Enoch walked with God, and then he was no more, because God had taken him away.
Then the Lordsaid to Noah, “Go into the ark, you and all your family, because I have found you righteous in this generation.
God looks down from heaven upon the sons of men to see if any understand, if any seek God.
All have turned away, they have together become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.
And after he had become the father of Methuselah, Enoch walked with God 300 years and had other sons and daughters.
For seven days from now I will send rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights, and I will wipe from the face of the earth every living thing I have made.”
Moses did everything just as the LORD had commanded him.
You are My friends if you do what I command you.

And Noah did all that the Lordhad commanded him.
Therefore everyone who hears these words of Mine and acts on them is like a wise man who built his house on the rock.
The rain fell, the torrents raged, and the winds blew and beat against that house, and it fell—and great was its collapse!”
His mother said to the servants, “Do whatever He tells you.”
